description: Variation of condition 03 of application: TP/02/1924 to allow the use class to be reclassified as use Class E.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Location PlanBlock PlanExisting Floor PlanReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification, the premises shall be used only as a café for the sale of food and drink principally to visiting members of the public where consumption of that food and drink is mostly undertaken on the premises (Class E(b)), and for no other purposes within Class E unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To protect the amenities of the residential occupiers above and to the rear of the site from noise, odour and other emissions associated with other uses within Class E.

Within three months of the date of this permission, a Waste Management Strategy for the café use shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The strategy shall include details of refuse and recycling storage, collection arrangements, and measures to minimise noise and odour from waste storage and collection. The café use shall thereafter operate in accordance with the approved strategy.Reason: To ensure adequate waste arrangements for the use and to protect the amenities of neighbouring residential occupiers.

The use hereby approved shall only be open to customers between the hours of 07:00 to 19:00 every day including Bank Holidays, and at no other times.Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers.
